## Discord invite
- The Discord button now opens the real invite link on the website, in the docs and in every app (Android, Windows, Linux, browser)
- The link is kept in one place, so it changes everywhere at once

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
